mapper.select: SELECT fin_ym AS "month",item_sn::int AS "itemSn",fin_cls_cd AS "finClass",sga_item_cd AS "sgaItemCode",item_nm AS "itemName", amt AS "amount",vat_amt AS "vatAmount",io_dt AS "ioDate",rpt_yn AS "repeat",rmrk AS "remark",auto_fill_yn AS "autoFill", upld_id::bigint AS "uploadId",reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_fi_item WHERE fin_ym=#{month} ORDER BY item_sn
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.fin_ym,f.item_sn),'[]'::jsonb)::text FROM tb_fi_item f WHERE f.fin_ym=#{month}

SELECT c.code_grp_id AS "groupId",c.code,c.code_nm AS "name",m.src_text AS "source" FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code_map m ON m.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id AND m.code=c.code WHERE c.code_grp_id IN ('FIN_CLS','SGA_ITEM') AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY c.code_grp_id,c.code,m.map_id
SELECT lpad(trunc(std_val)::text,6,'0') FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_ym=#{month} AND close_stat_cd='CLOSE')
mapper.sql: upld_id::bigint AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS "filename",file_size::bigint AS "size",trgt_ym AS "month",trgt_proj_id AS "projectId",trgt_dstrb_step_cd AS "step",reg_user_id AS "actor",upld_stat_cd AS "status",tot_row_cnt::int AS "totalRows",succ_cnt::int AS "successRows",warn_cnt::int AS "warningRows",err_cnt::int AS "errorRows",aply_dttm AS "appliedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT rslt_sn::int AS "sequence",rslt_type_cd AS "severity",row_no::int AS "rowNumber",coalesce(col_nm,'') AS "columnName",coalesce(input_val,'') AS "inputValue",rsn_cn AS "reason" FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY rslt_sn
SELECT chg_item_nm AS "item",aft_val AS "value" FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_UPLD' AND trgt_key=CAST(#{uploadId} AS text) AND chg_rsn='B2 문맥' ORDER BY hist_id

SELECT split_part(chg_rsn,':',3)::int AS "rowNumber",split_part(trgt_key,':',2) AS "itemSn" FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_FI_ITEM' AND chg_type_cd='NEW' AND chg_item_nm='ITEM_NM' AND chg_rsn LIKE ('B2:' || CAST(#{uploadId} AS text) || ':%') ORDER BY "rowNumber"
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_fi_item WHERE fin_ym=#{month} AND upld_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_upld SET upld_stat_cd='APPLIED',aply_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='CHECKED'
